title: 5th Anniversary Card Express
lines: As the sands of time swiftly pass, we're about to celebrate an important milestone—our 5th Anniversary with Arknights. In honor of this joyous occasion, Pepe will be organizing a special 5th Anniversary Card Express Event, ensuring that the heartfelt greeting cards and well wishes from Doctor reach every corner of Terra, spreading the festive spirit far and wide.
*We recommend participating in the event on your PC for an optimal experience.
SEND A CARD: Doctors can use the tools on the official site to create their own greeting cards, to share their wishes and thoughts for the new year with them ( Maximum 3 cards per person )

READ A CARD: After making and sending your first card, Pepe will begin to deliver the greeting cards sent by the Doctors and the card checking option to read other submissions will be unlocked, so read and give Likes to your favorites, and you might find some surprises waiting for you~ ( You can read up to a maximum of 30 cards per day, and this limit will be lifted during the final stage of the event )
MESSAGES: Check how many people have Liked your work! ( Data will refresh daily at 12:00 and 00:00 )

GEM APPRAISAL: When you submit a card, you will receive a rough stone. Remember to visit Sand Reckoner for appraisal. Complete event tasks, collect three different colored gems, and participate in the lucky draw during the lucky draw period!
How to enter the Lucky Draw:

Participate in the webpage event once you've collected one red, one blue, and one yellow gem, you'll be eligible to participate in the lucky draw! The lucky draw will open on January 21st at 21:00 (UTC-7). Doctors must be level 20 and above to qualify, and each account can only participate once for a chance to win 600 Ordundum and Gift Cards.
1. Each submission must consist of customized text as well as drawings and stickers provided by the website. Cards that lack customized text or are filled with spam only will be invalidated.
2. Submissions with content related to politics, violence, pornography, grotesque, controversy, or those violating the rules will be invalidated. Commercial contents are also prohibited.

3. By submitting the card, the creator agrees to allow Yostar the right to use the work in official Arknights content or on its and its affiliates' social platform accounts. The ownership of the work and other rights remain with the creator.

4. The final explanation of the activity belongs to Yostar Games, the operation team of Arknights. If players find any violations against the rules or have any questions, please feel free to contact us: arknights.event@yo-star.com .
